purpose: Ensure encouraging Phase 2B source-stress morphology is not lost or hidden by source-to-wall mapping, chamber kinematics, afterload, or free gains before Level 3 loaded protocols are interpreted.

entryRequirements.description: The Phase 2B report includes the required mechanistic fields from phase2b-source-stress-mechanistic-report-v1.
The report distinguishes targetPeakAmplitudeUM from targetAbsolutePeakCaUM and shows measuredPeakCaUM relative to the absolute target.

The Phase 2B source-stress peak is compared against the Land 2017 intact-human reference or expected scale at the same lambda/Ca condition. This check is intended to catch nominal/Cauchy or constant-factor mistakes before calibration can hide them.

Level 3 must verify that Phase 2B source stress around 37 kPa transfers to chamber-realized stress in the expected approximate 10-16 kPa range and approximately 120 mmHg morphology without Tref rescaling or free gain. Exact thresholds must come from the target pack and source-to-wall mapping decision.
No hidden Tref rescale, geomChi-style pressure multiplier, or homogenization gain may be introduced to force Level 3 agreement.
FWHM, time-to-peak, relaxation tau, and Ca-to-stress delay from Phase 2B are carried forward for recheck after loaded single-chamber, partitioned coupling, and closed-loop integration.

alternansPolicy.legacyProtocol: Legacy activeStress alternans should be reproduced under a fixed protocol before claiming improvement.
alternansPolicy.newProtocol: New myocardium should be checked under the same protocol.
alternansPolicy.referenceRequirement: Final no-alternans interpretation must not rely on BE alone; SDIRK2 or an equivalent second-order reference is required before treating alternans disappearance as robust.
